scope: Order construction for the fixed policy that retries its current job until completion, allows r global cheap failures, then freshly cached-completes remaining jobs. Only minimum worst W among fixed topological orders; Q and L envelopes remain order independent.
old_inputs: All5421 previously observed weighted-DAG cases from charged_resource_frontier_01/INPUTS.json, unchanged case order and values
new_inputs: 96 authored seeded DAG cases: sizes5,6,7; densities0,.15,.4,.75;8instances each, seed20260909, works uniformly1..9; all edges sampled in a randomly permuted topological order
other_inputs: One empty degenerate case and the already-reasoned independent1,2,3 illustration; neither counted as held-out
evaluation: For every fixed input, enumerate every legal topological order before results. Evaluate the policy's direct W recurrence for all32budget/slack pairs; check the closed form and compare the constructed order with all legal orders. Save every order outcome and all minima. This is a new mathematical finite check on mostly observed inputs, zero native measurements.
controls: Before outcome recording fix six rejected artifacts: wrong input hash, duplicate job, missing job, boolean job ID, nonready job, nonminimum ready work. Include one accepted alternative equal-weight tie. Keep controls separate from scientific case count.
failure_policy: SUCCESS,FAILURE,TIMEOUT,INVALID,UNSTARTED partition for every fixed order unit and case; no exclusion, replacement or retry. Any wrong greedy minimum or formula/direct mismatch falsifies the tested claim. Original studies and outcomes remain immutable.
not_claimed: full causal-program W optimality for r>0
